key_expressions: Do you see your family often?

A: How is your family?
Oh, sounds like a warm family!
Tell me more about them someday!
B: I live with my parents and an older sister.
Everyone gets along well.
Sure, I can share more later!

A: Do you have any siblings?
Oh, that’s similar to me!
Your family seems really close!
B: Yes, I have a younger brother.
We play games together and get along well.
Yeah, we’re pretty close.

A: What do your parents do?
Oh, they must work really hard!
I really respect that.
B: My dad works at a company, and my mom runs a small shop.
They’re busy but enjoy what they do.
Thanks for saying that!

A: Where does your family live?
Oh, your hometown must feel nice!
I’d love to visit someday.
B: My family lives outside the city.
It’s quiet and comfortable there.
You’re welcome anytime!

A: Do you see your family often?
Oh, that must make you closer.
Makes me want to visit my family too.
B: Yes, I try to see them every weekend.
Talking and eating together makes me feel better.
Yeah, family gives a lot of strength.

A: Who are you closest to in your family?
Oh, sounds like you two get along great!
You must spend lots of time together.
B: I’m closest to my sister.
We have similar personalities and talk a lot.
Yes, we chat often.

A: Do you travel with your family often?
Oh, must be lots of memories!
I bet you took many photos!
B: We used to travel often, but not recently.
Still, the memories are special.
Yes, looking at photos makes me miss it.

A: How do you celebrate birthdays in your family?
Oh, that sounds warm and cozy!
I like simple birthdays like that too.
B: We usually celebrate quietly at home.
Just cake and talking together is enough.
Yeah, simple feels better.

A: Do you share similar personalities with your family?
Oh, that makes things easier!
No wonder you get along well!
B: Yes, I’m a bit like my dad.
I’m pretty calm, like him.
Hearing that makes me happy.

A: How is it living away from your family?
Oh, I understand that feeling.
But staying in touch helps a lot!
B: Sometimes I miss them and feel lonely.
But I call them often, so it’s okay.
Yeah, calls make a big difference.
